source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service test entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Centrifugal switch (motor)
steps.body: Motor centrifugal contacts (1M–6M): start winding closes 1M–2M and 3M–5M; run winding closes 1M–2M, 3M–5M, and 5M–6M. Verify contacts with motor stopped vs drum spinning.

steps.title: Belt safety prerequisite
steps.body: Confirm belt safety switch passes (nstdre75w1-belt-safety) before condemning motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Confirm belt safety switch passes (nstdre75w1-belt-safety) before condemning motor.

steps.title: Motor runs with belt on
steps.body: With belt installed and door closed, does motor start and drum turn?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With belt installed and door closed, does motor start and drum turn?

steps.title: Replace motor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace motor assembly — centrifugal or winding fault.

steps.title: Motor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Motor runs; belt safety and centrifugal logic OK.
